title: Add audit retention, export, and redaction gates
purpose: Define audit export and retention behavior for support bundles and production-distro operations.
scope: Define audit retention policy, export manifest, hash chain validation, and redaction report.
Define local audit export smoke and secret-like rejection fixture.
Define how remote audit mirror status appears in operator projection.
Define release evidence for audit export gates.
implementation_steps: Define export manifest schema and retention rules.
Define redaction gate for secret-like summaries.
Record evidence with valid and secret-like export fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Export manifest binds audit event range and hash chain.
Secret-like audit data is redacted or export-blocked.
Remote mirror failure mode is visible and policy-aware.
Retention policy is explicit and testable.
failure_modes: Retention policy deletes unresolved effect evidence.
Remote mirror failure silently allows non-local side effects when policy forbids it.

blocked_until: Audit export and redaction gate contract exists.
